title: Every task along the way
description: The working day’s route with a card for every stop: contact, task, notes and the result of the last visit.

blocks.text: A work route has not only addresses but also a required order: where to pick up materials, who to visit first, where to finish the shift. An automatic route may not take these conditions into account.

quote.text: Defining start/last stop/1st stop has left the chat! Want to reorganize what it calculates for you? Sorry no ain’t happening. I love that I can see all my stops on the map in one view, that is the number 1 critical detail I need. But it won’t let me organize the stops how I

blocks.text: Show the stops on a map and in a list, and allow the first and last to be pinned. Keep the contact, the task and the result with the visit. After a manual change, recalculate the route without cancelling the pinned conditions.
Take a person’s route with its known constraints and ask them to change one stop. It should be clear to them what changed. A promise to cut travel time needs separate testing on real trips.
